literal: Even if they mistakenly understand, foolishness will not speak they who have subtly analyzed and accumulated learning by listening.
translation: Those who have acquired deep knowledge by listening and subtly analyzing things will never utter foolish words, even if they happen to misunderstand something.
modern: நுட்பமாக ஆராய்ந்து திரட்டிய கேள்வி அறிவு உடையவர்கள், ஒருவேளை தவறாகப் புரிந்து கொண்டாலும், வாய்தவறியும் அறிவற்ற சொற்களைச் சொல்ல மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the profound impact of 'கேள்வி' (learning by listening to the wise). Those who have carefully analyzed and accumulated such knowledge possess a refined mind. Even if they occasionally misunderstand a concept ('பிழைத்துணர்ந்தும்'), their deep-rooted wisdom prevents them from speaking foolishly ('பேதைமை சொல்லார்'). The key words 'இழைத்துணர்ந்து' (subtly analyzing) and 'ஈண்டிய' (accumulated) emphasize that true listening is an active, deep process that safeguards one's speech from ignorance.
